UBL.d: United Breweries Limited manufactures and sells beer, holding the largest market share in India's beer industry. Its main products include Kingfisher, and its customers are consumers of alcoholic beverages.

UCOBANK.d: UCO Bank is a state-owned commercial bank providing retail, corporate, and international banking services. Its main customers include individuals, agricultural borrowers, and businesses across India.

UDS.d: Updater Services Limited provides integrated facilities management and business support services. Its main customers are corporate offices, manufacturing plants, and institutions across India.

UEL.d: Ujaas Energy develops, builds, owns, and operates solar power plant systems. It also provides solar power plant installation services to commercial and industrial customers.

UFLEX.d: UFLEX manufactures flexible packaging materials, plastic films, and printing inks. Its products serve global consumer goods companies in food, pharmaceuticals, and other industries.

UGROCAP.d: Ugro Capital Limited is a non-banking financial company that provides business loans to micro, small, and medium enterprises. It utilizes a data-driven technology platform to serve underserved credit markets across India.

UJJIVANSFB.d: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank Limited provides banking and financial services, focusing on unserved and underserved segments. Its main customers include micro-banking clients, small businesses, and retail depositors.

ULTRACEMCO.d: UltraTech Cement manufactures and sells grey cement, white cement, and ready-mix concrete. It is India's largest cement manufacturer, serving construction and infrastructure sectors.

UNICHEMLAB.d: Unichem Laboratories Limited manufactures and markets active pharmaceutical ingredients and generic finished formulations. The company supplies prescription drugs globally across multiple therapeutic segments.

UNIECOM.d: Unicommerce Esolutions Limited provides software-as-a-service products for e-commerce enablement, warehouse management, and omnichannel fulfillment. Its main customers are online retailers, brands, and logistics service providers.

UNIMECH.d: Unimech Aerospace and Manufacturing produces precision machined components and assemblies. Its main customers are global aerospace, defense, and energy original equipment manufacturers.

UNIONBANK.d: Union Bank of India provides retail, corporate, and agricultural banking services across the country. It is a major state-owned public sector bank controlled by the Government of India.

UNIPARTS.d: Uniparts India Limited manufactures engineered systems and components for off-highway vehicles. Its customers are global original equipment manufacturers in agriculture and construction.

UNITDSPR.d: United Spirits manufactures, distributes, and sells alcoholic beverages, including whisky, brandy, and rum. It is a subsidiary of Diageo and serves adult consumers primarily in India.

UNITECH.d: Unitech Limited develops residential and commercial real estate projects in India. The state-managed company constructs housing complexes and office spaces for individual and corporate customers.

UNITEDPOLY.d: United Polyfab Gujarat manufactures and trades cotton yarn, grey fabric, and finished textile products. It supplies domestic and international textile and apparel manufacturers.

UNIVCABLES.d: Universal Cables manufactures power cables, control cables, and special cables for power transmission and industrial use. It is part of the M.P. Birla Group.

UNOMINDA.d: The company manufactures and supplies automotive components and accessories, including lighting, switches, and alloy wheels, to major vehicle manufacturers.

UPL.d: UPL manufactures and markets agrochemicals, industrial chemicals, and seed varieties for global agricultural markets. It serves farmers and agribusiness customers worldwide.

USHAMART.d: Usha Martin manufactures wire ropes, specialty steel, and related products used in mining, infrastructure, and maritime sectors. It is a prominent global producer of high-performance wire ropes.

UTIAMC.d: UTI Asset Management Company manages mutual funds, pension funds, and portfolio management services for retail and institutional investors. It is one of the largest asset management companies in India.

UTKARSHBNK.d: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank Limited provides banking and financial services, focusing on microfinance and unserved segments. It offers retail banking, MSME loans, and savings products across India.

UTTAMSUGAR.d: Uttam Sugar Mills manufactures and sells refined sugar, molasses, and ethanol. It operates sugar mills and supplies products to industrial consumers and retail markets in India.
